en: Black-and-white postcard view of a small railway station complex with low brick buildings, loading ramps and freight sheds. Railway tracks and overhead electric lines run across the foreground. A sign on a rear building reads "STALLDALEN," and in the lower left corner printed text identifies the location. A logo at the bottom right corner reads "PRESSBYRÅN Copyright 73297," indicating a commercial postcard publisher.
